data.name: Apex Road Racer
data.description: A lightweight carbon race bike built for long climbs and fast group rides. Stiff enough to sprint, light enough to forget it's there on a five-hour day.

faqs.question: Is this bike tubeless-ready?
faqs.answer: Yes, both wheels come taped and ready for tubeless tires and sealant.

faqs.question: What's the max tire clearance?
faqs.answer: 32mm, enough for light gravel without rubbing.
